topic: How Light, Sound, and Heat Travel
key_concepts: Transparent materials let light pass through completely
Translucent materials allow some light to pass through
Sound is produced by vibration of particles
The speed of sound depends on the medium and particle arrangement
Conduction is heat transfer through direct contact
Convection is heat transfer by movement of warm and cold air or liquid
Radiation transfers heat without direct contact, such as from the sun
Metals are good conductors of heat
